description: Page capture: screenshot or PDF of a public URL — Renders one public web page in a real browser (Cloudflare Browser Run, JavaScript enabled) and returns a PNG or JPEG screenshot or a PDF as base64 with its sha256, for agents that need to see or archive a page. Does not log in, click or fill forms, does not capture private or internal hosts, and returns an error rather than a capture larger than 6 MB.

full_page.description: Capture the full scroll height (screenshots only; a PDF is always the whole page).

name: page-capture
